Problem Statement:
Ramnath is a farmer who grows apples. He packs apples in batches of fixed sizes and transports it from Kashmir to Odisha. On the way, he checks if any of the apples have become spoilt. Even if one of the apples in a box is spoilt, he discards the entire box as there is a possibility that the others might become spoilt soon. Before discarding the box, he marks every apple in the box with an ‘x’ which indicates that the apples in the box are spoilt. The boxes are stacked one on top of another. A spoilt apple in a box is indicated by ‘x’ and a healthy one is indicated by ‘a’. Find out the final set of good and bad apples. 
Input Description:
Number of apples in a box, Number of boxes and initial condition of all apples (‘a’ for healthy and ‘x’ for spoilt). 
Output Description:
Final condition of all the apples in the boxes 
Explanation:
As one apple is spoilt in boxes 2 and 4, all the apples in the boxes are marked ‘x’ before discarding the boxes. 
Sample Input:
3 4
a a a
a x a
a a a
a a x 
Sample Output:
A a a
X x x
A a a
X x x
